title: Data Analyst
description:
TapGoods


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent. 


There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers. 


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve. 


Data Analyst Role


We need a Data Analyst to join our team to fulfill our customers’ reporting needs. Our cloud platform provides analytics and reporting to our customers to help them manage their rental business. We’ve built a data warehouse and are moving our canned reports into embedded Power BI reports. 


This role would work closely with the product team and engineers to take our reporting to the next level. 


Responsibilities 


  • Use Power BI to create reports using our data warehouse 
  • Look for insights in our data that can provide value to our customers 
  • Maintain the Snowflake data warehouse dimensional model 
  • Be a part of our engineering team 
  • Able to work fully remote with adequate internet speeds, workspace, zoom capabilities (good mic, headset, etc.), and multiple monitors 


Requirements 


  • 1-3 years of experience with SQL 
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools 
  • Experience with Power Query M 
  • Experience with Snowflake data warehouse 
  • Understanding data models for OLAP vs OLTP 
  • Experience with dimensional modeling/star schemas 
  • An unstoppable internal drive 
  • A great attitude and work ethic 
  • Solution oriented, self starter, and team player 
  • SaaS experience is a plus 


Our Culture


We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 


We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

title: Scrum Master Sr
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem uma oportunidade imediata para Scrum Masters experientes e com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e transformação de negócios através do lean-agile. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades. Junte-se ao nosso time e seja um agente facilitador de resultados de negócios através dos conceitos de Business Agility, Lean, Agile, Kanban e SAFe.


O Scrum Master trabalhará com equipes de entrega ágil para aprimorar e habilitar o desempenho de nível de equipe e entrega de valor usando o Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).


Duties and Responsibilities:

· Coach de equipes referentes aos valores e princípios lean-agile;

· Facilitar cerimônias ágeis no nível de time (Retrospectiva, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Planning, Refining), garantindo o entendimento e engajamento total da equipe em tais;

· Promover o mindset e práticas de melhoria contínua para as equipes ágeis;

· Integração das melhores práticas e padrões de agilidade em um contexto altamente regulado;

· Fomentar o senso de responsabilidade compartilhada nas equipes e stakeholders;

· Facilitar a resolução de ou impedimentos existentes para os times;

· Gerenciar interdependências entre equipes ágeis;

· Trabalhar com Product Owners para apoiar o planejamento de Curto Prazo e evolução da definição/priorização do Backlog de produto do time;

· Proteger as equipes de interferências externas que possam impactar princípios de agilidade, produtividade da equipe e/ou estágio de formação da equipe;

· Participar e auxiliar na facilitação de todas as cerimônias em um ambiente ágil escalado (SAFe Essential);


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

· Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master/Agile Master (conhecimento será testado);

· Experiência em ambiente regido pelas cerimônias do SAFe

· Vivência de TI em projetos de desenvolvimento de soluções complexas e de alta disponibilidade

· Experiência com diferentes modelos, métricas e cerimônias no nível de equipe ágil

· Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento de trabalho ágil (Jira), incluindo configuração, planejamento e relatórios

· Capacidade promover agilidade em diferentes cenários sendo responsável por garantir que as equipes entendam e operem de acordo com os valores e princípios de agilidade

· Conhecimento em outros métodos e práticas ágeis além do Scrum

Minimum Education:

· Bachelor’s Degree

Required Certifications:

· Possuir certificação KMP, PSPM e MGT 3.0

· Possuir certificação SAFe (plus)


Other:

· English (plus)

title: Dev Sênior React / Node (com VTEX) (BRL 15-16K/mês PJ)
description:
Nosso cliente atua em uma etapa da compra online conhecida como "checkout" - trata-se do momento em que o consumidor precisa finalizar a compra, preenchendo o cadastro e informações de pagamento.


Em integração com os serviços de lojistas, nosso cliente oferece um sistema que preenche automaticamente os dados do comprador na hora de fechar compras.


Para fazer isso, a plataforma da startup funciona com cadastros únicos para diferentes lojas: depois que o cliente faz uma primeira compra em uma loja, as informações ficam armazenadas para serem usadas em outras lojas cadastradas no sistema do nosso cliente.


O modelo de negócios da empresa funciona com cobranças nas transações.


DESCRIÇÃO DO SKILL SET

  • Experiência como Desenvolvedor Frontend e Backend React / Node (5 anos +);
  • Experiência com a plataforma VTEX
  • Experiência com React;
  • Experiência com Javascript e Typescript;
  • Experiência com arquitetura;
  • Experiência com definição de tecnologias e arquitetura;
  • Conhecimento de Cloud AWS, Heroku e MongoDB

title: Senior FullStack Developer (Java+React) [Portugal]
description:
This vacancy is for our Portuguese team and you will have to relocate to Portugal.


We’re launching a new partnership with a valued client in fintech, and we’re growing our team to support this exciting collaboration

Client is a financial sciences company, combining data analysis, invention, and rigorous inquiry to help solve the toughest challenges in investment management, insurance technology, securities, private equity, and venture capital.


Project Overview:

The platform is a portfolio analytics tool used by asset owners, asset managers, and advisors.

The platform applies the best expertise in research, data science, and technology to modernize the analytics experience for institutional investors, helping them embrace a quantitative approach to multi-asset portfolio risk and investment decision making.

The available tools help investors perform factor-based risk analysis to inform manager due diligence, investment evaluation, and portfolio construction.

The client's headquarters is in the USA

We are seeking an experienced, full-stack Software Engineer to help own the innovation, technical design, and development of the platform.

Technology Stack:

  • Cloud based, modern web application stack using Java, Typescript, React.js
  • Apollo GraphQL as an popular open-source ecosystem for building and managing GraphQL APIs
  • Service oriented architecture, infrastructure-as-code
  • Continuous development and deployment
  • Auto-scaling and robust search (Postgres, OpenSearch)
  • Cloud technologies (AWS)
  • Cloud monitoring (Datadog)
  • Test automation (Cypress)


Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience preferred building and delivering customer facing products
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
  • 7+ years of Experience with Java development
  • 3+ years of Experience with modern front-end technologies: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript**
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, test automation, DevOps and cloud technologies (AWS preferred)
  • Prior experience with systems design, building enterprise SaaS solutions, experience with user research, and product analytics are a major plus
  • Strong communication skills , keen attention to detail, readiness to challenge assumptions and obsession with building quality software


Responsibilities:

  • Create, design, build and deploy SaaS product end to end with an agile approach, from conceptualization, through rigorous testing, and partnering with client´s multi-functional teams to ensure an outstanding in-product UX
  • Conduct front-end web development using React, TypeScript, CSS, and other technologies
  • Perform API design and development in Java, using cloud, microservices, and caching
  • Become a domain expert and trusted advisor in the full-stack software engineering field
  • Contribute to the continuous learning approach of the team by bringing in new insights, welcoming them from others, and generating even stronger outcomes as a result
  • Provide hands-on coding support and perform code reviews to ensure quality standards
  • Communicate clearly about progress, challenges, and technical decisions

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.
  • Validate data integrity through SQL queries and support backend testing.
  • Troubleshoot issues by analyzing logs, debugging test failures, and collaborating closely with development teams.
  • Work with JIRA for requirement management and defect tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, collaborate across global teams, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience with Selenium , including locators, waits, and driver configuration.
  • Strong experience in REST API testing, including JSON/XML validation, HTTP verbs, Postman, and Swagger.
  • Good experience with Java , including control structures, exception handling, and database queries.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, including DML, joins, and basic schema definitions.
  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.
  • Hands-on experience with Cucumber , including writing feature files and step definitions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work with distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of software testing best practices, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Allure reporting.
  • Background in test strategy definition or QA process improvements.
  • Exposure to DevOps practices or willingness to learn.
  • Experience in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

description:

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Front-End Developer with a strong foundation in modern web technologies to help us craft performant, scalable, and user-centric digital experiences. You’ll play a key role in building and maintaining a hybrid SSR-enabled front-end architecture powered by React or Next.js, while collaborating cross-functionally with design, product, and backend teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain responsive, device-optimized user interfaces using React or Next.js, leveraging SSR/SSG for performance and SEO.
  • Integrate with a headless CMS (Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity) to support localization and rapid content iterations.
  • Build and extend reusable front-end component libraries using Storybook (or similar) to ensure consistent design implementation.
  • Collaborate with designers in Figma to translate design systems into robust, maintainable UI components.
  • Work with the API Gateway / BFF (Backend for Frontend) layer to consume and aggregate APIs for multi-channel delivery, including integrating with Drupal APIs.
  • Style components using Tailwind CSS and maintain scalable, accessible CSS organization.
  • Optimize build and deployment pipelines using Vite for fast, modern front-end delivery.
  • Ensure code quality, performance, and accessibility across the stack.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in front-end development building production-grade applications.

title: Tech Lead .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Atribuições:

- Definir e propor soluções técnicas alinhadas aos desafios do negócio, liderando o desenho da arquitetura com foco em performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

- Organizar e acompanhar as atividades do time de desenvolvimento, promovendo alinhamento técnico e fluidez na entrega de valor.

- Supervisionar a implementação das soluções, assegurando aderência aos padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de engenharia e governança de código.

- Promover o uso de boas práticas como testes automatizados, code review, integração continua, documentação técnica e segurança desde o desenvolvimento.

- Atuar com mentoria técnica, contribuindo para o crescimento da equipe por meio de orientação, feedbacks e compartilhamento de conhecimento.

- Ser o elo técnico entre o time de desenvolvimento e áreas parceiras como Produto, Segurança, Infraestrutura e demais squads.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core / C# – domínio da linguagem e do framework para construção de APIs e aplicações backend.

- Mensageria – conhecimento prático em RabbitMQ e Apache Kakfa .

- Cache e performance – uso de Redis para otimização de consultas e redução de latência.

- Bancos de dados relacionais – domínio em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem, tunning de queries e boas práticas de banco de dados.

- Experiência prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads ágeis.

- Vivência em ambientes com esteiras de CI/CD , testes automatizados e pipelines de deploy.

- Experiência com times que atuam no ecossistema de meios de pagamento .

- Boa comunicação , com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos complexos em linguagem acessível para áreas não técnicas.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Desenvolvimento Java AWS - Pleno - 124105
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Assistência Médica;

Seguro de Vida.

title: Enterprise Support Engineer
description:
About HotMic


HotMic builds AI-powered video creation workflows that help creators and media teams produce high-quality content faster and more efficiently. We operate our own platform and also work closely with large enterprise customers to deliver custom, high-impact solutions.

We are hiring a Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to work directly with one major enterprise customer.   • Experience working in structured team sprints.
  • Background working with enterprise customers or complex implementations.
  • Comfortable in a mixed engineering + support role.
  • Strong teamwork and ability to work independently.

title: Internal Audit and SOX
description:
Ready to build the future with AI?

At Genpact, we don’t just keep up with technology—we set the pace. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. If you thrive in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.


VAGA EXTENSIVA PARA PESSOAS COM DEFICIÊNCIA (PCD)


In this role, you will be responsible for working on projects encompassing the entire gamut of Sox – from conceptualization to designing to implementation of the entire SOX program including documentation and control testing, evaluating internal controls, reliability of financial reporting, compliance with applicable laws and regulations and effectiveness and efficiency of operations including cost management. This should be a detailed SOX framework implementer role


Responsibilities:


  • Ability to interact with process owners in Portuguese
  • Play a key role in the assignments including developing project plans, allocating resources, and leading staff members.
  • Handle SOX and Audit engagements.
  • Exposure to Internal Audit, Process Reviews, SOP, and other risk management engagements would be a positive.
  • Design and assess process and controls and drive improvements.
  • Ability to address queries on SOX and audit issues.
  • Understand the COSO 2013 and experience in process documentation, developing RCMs, report writing, root cause analysis, remediation and should be able to provide mentorship to the other team members.



Qualifications we seek in you! Minimum qualifications / skills

  • SOX and Internal Audit Professional
  • ACCA
  • Graduate + CIA
  • Experience in service delivery, team handling, work with all levels of staff and supervision of team member
  • Good analytical and communication skills in both Portuguese and English
  • Good understanding of technical platforms and risk management practices.


Preferred qualifications / skills


  • Preferred experience of working in international client facing roles on SOX and Audit engagements.
  • Qualified Accountant / Auditor with one or more degrees like CA, CPA, CIA, MBA
  • Required overall experience in internal and/or external audit, process re-engineering, process reviews, Sarbanes-Oxley implementation, Finance function or risk management function at a Top Corporate. With meaningful experience in SOX projects.
  • Must be able to work, at times, multiple assignments simultaneously.
  • Excellent report writing and presentation skills, an analytical mind, and problem solving abilities.
  • Position requires the ability to work effectively with all levels of staff and balance confidential information discretely and expertly
  • Good PC skills, including Word, Excel, Visio.
  • Excellent communication and teaming skills. For Associate Consultants, reasonable interpersonal skills are a must




Why join Genpact?

  • Lead AI-first transformation – Build and scale AI solutions that redefine industries
  • Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter
  • Accelerate your career —Gain hands-on experience, world-class training, mentorship, and AI certifications to advance your skills
  • Grow with the best – Learn from top engineers, data scientists, and AI experts in a dynamic, fast-moving workplace
  • Committed to ethical AI – Work in an environment where governance, transparency, and security are at the core of everything we build
  • Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the 140,000+ coders, tech shapers, and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 2+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.


You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.


At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.



REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.



What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Software Engineer (Chinese)
description:
Job Title: LLM Trainer – Chinese

Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Pay: Up to $35/hour


About the Role

This is a contract opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI projects. The role involves designing realistic conversations in Chinese to train and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You’ll be simulating real-world interactions between users and AI assistants, ensuring natural, context-aware, and logically sound dialogues.


Responsibilities

  • Create multi-turn conversations between users and AI assistants.
  • Simulate real-world tool usage (e.g., calendar, maps, email).
  • Ensure dialogues follow formatting and quality guidelines.
  • Collaborate with peers and reviewers to maintain consistency.
  • Iterate based on feedback to improve realism and accuracy.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in a technical or analytical field.
  • Strong grasp of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) , JSON , and logical reasoning.
  • Native or professional proficiency in Chinese + strong written English.
  • Experience with LLMs, conversational AI, or virtual assistants is a plus.
  • Creativity, attention to detail, and ability to follow structured guidelines.


Perks

  • Fully remote role.
  • Flexible working hours (with some overlap in PST).
  • Work on impactful AI projects with global reach.

title: Technical Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Sourcing Specialist based in Latin America with 2+ years of experience and excellent English communication skills — both written and spoken.


You’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and connecting top technical talent — including software engineers, developers, and other IT professionals — through platforms like LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing channels.


At Velozient, we’re a fast-moving, growth-stage company that values smart, proactive people who love connecting with others and enjoy the challenge of finding the best talent. You’ll play a key role in building and nurturing a high-quality pipeline that drives our hiring success.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively source, identify, and engage technical candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future technical roles.
  • Partner closely with Recruiters and Resource Managers to deeply understand technical requirements and deliver high-quality leads.
  • Conduct initial outreach and screening conversations to assess technical fit, interest level, and alignment with open positions.
  • Develop targeted search strategies using advanced Boolean logic, filters, and data mining techniques.
  • Track sourcing activity and candidate engagement using internal systems and tools.
  • Stay up to date on market trends, technologies, and sourcing innovations to improve talent pipelines continuously.
  • Represent Velozient’s brand professionally and enthusiastically in all candidate interactions.
  • Support diversity sourcing initiatives and help drive inclusive hiring practices.



REQUIRED Experience:

  • Excellent English skills — both written and verbal.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of experience in candidate sourcing or talent acquisition, with a focus on technical roles (e.g., software engineering, IT, data, or product).
  • Proven experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
  • Strong understanding of Boolean search, technical keyword targeting, and sourcing best practices.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree.
  • Prior experience sourcing for North American-based companies.
  • Experience in a growth-stage or entrepreneurial organization.



What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Analista de Planejamento e Inteligência de Mercado II
description:
A Voltz é a fintech do Grupo Energisa.


Somos um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis e geradores de valor nos ecossistemas de serviços básicos.


Começamos com a oferta de serviços digitais para pessoas físicas e expandimos nossa atuação para meios de pagamento e soluções para gestão financeira.


Além disso, oferecemos possibilidades de negociação para consumidores de serviços essenciais e crédito para fornecedores.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


O dia a dia:

• Conduzir pesquisas de mercado, monitorar tendências, perfis de concorrentes, cenários emergentes e oportunidades de crescimento (por exemplo: avaliar segmentos inexplorados, modelagem de cenário);


• Mapear novos negócios: apoiar iniciativas de pré-análise, desenvolver business cases, estimativas de mercado, participação provável, modelos de monetização;


• Acompanhar metas estratégicas, táticas e operacionais: definir painéis de indicadores (KPIs), monitorar progresso, identificar desvios, sugerir ações corretivas;


• Preparar relatórios e apresentações executivas periódicas (mensais, trimestrais) para a diretoria: sintetizar dados, contar a “história” por trás dos números, transformar informação em insight e recomendação;

• Apoiar a implementação de processos e ritos de governança de metas, alinhamento de coordenações/produtos e interface com outras áreas (Crédito, Cobrança, Produto, Negócios);


• Gerar e manter base de dados de inteligência de mercado/concorrência, dashboards, relatórios de desempenho e painéis de acompanhamento;


• Colaborar com outras áreas para garantir que as informações estejam atualizadas, consistentes e disponíveis para decisão.



Requisitos e qualificações

• Formação superior (Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing, Estatística ou afins).


• Experiência prévia (2-4 anos ou mais) em inteligência de mercado, novos negócios, análise competitiva ou similar;


• Sólidas habilidades analíticas e de interpretação de dados: capacidade de extrair padrões, insights e implicações para o negócio


• Boa habilidade de comunicação, para preparar relatórios executivos e interagir com níveis de gerência e diretoria;


• Familiaridade ou vontade de aprender ferramentas de BI/visualização de dados (Excel avançado, Power BI/Tableau, SQL ou equivalente) embora foco não seja engenharia de dados pesada;


• Proatividade, curiosidade estratégica, visão de negócio, capacidade de trabalhar com ambiguidade e traduzir dados em recomendação;


• Será considerando um diferencial: experiência ou familiaridade com segmento de fintech, crédito ou área financeira, considerando seu contexto de produto de crédito.


Informações adicionais


OS BENEFÍCIOS PARA OS VOLTZERS


  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação.
  • Wellhub;
  • Horário flexível;

title: Consultor de Recrutamento Júnior
description:
Recém-formado(a)? Fala inglês fluente e quer construir uma carreira onde sua renda depende diretamente dos seus esforços?

Nossa startup de recrutamento está buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Recrutamento Júnior .

Não buscamos um especialista pronto. Buscamos alguém com "brilho nos olhos", que possamos treinar no verdadeiro modelo 360  (sim, isso inclui Vendas e Recrutamento!). Você estará na origem da empresa, trabalhando lado a lado com os fundadores.

O que você vai fazer (e o que vamos te ensinar):

  • Parte 1: Negociação e Vendas (Prospecção)
  • Prospectar e atrair novos clientes (B2B), usando LinkedIn e contatos "frios".
  • Aprender a negociar com Diretores de RH e CEOs, fechando contratos de R&S.
  • Desenvolver relações de longo prazo com as empresas, tornando-se um parceiro estratégico.
  • Parte 2: Recrutamento (Delivery)
  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de recrutamento (do briefing com o cliente até a oferta).
  • Fazer "hunting" ativo dos melhores candidatos do mercado, que não estão em busca de emprego.
  • Conduzir entrevistas, avaliar perfis e apresentar os candidatos aos clientes.

Nosso(a) candidato(a) ideal:

  • Possui Ensino Superior completo.
  • Fala Inglês em nível avançado/fluente (conversacional)  — você vai se comunicar com candidatos e clientes internacionais.
  • Tem excelentes habilidades de comunicação:  você não tem medo de telefone, sabe ouvir, articula bem as ideias e tem poder de persuasão.
  • Tem um enorme desejo de se desenvolver  em negociação (vendas) e recrutamento (R&S).
  • É autônomo(a), proativo(a) e pronto(a) para atuar no ambiente dinâmico de uma startup.

Experiência prévia em R&S ou vendas é um diferencial, mas seu desejo e suas habilidades de comunicação são mais importantes.

O que oferecemos:

  • 100% Remoto (Home Office):  Trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Treinamento intensivo no modelo 360:  Vamos investir em você e transformá-lo(a) em um(a) consultor(a) de ponta.
  • Plano de carreira transparente:  Critérios claros de crescimento de Júnior a Sócio(a).
  • Salário e Motivação:  Salário base  competitivo (CLT) + alta remuneração variável (comissão)  baseada em seus resultados comerciais.
  • Impacto direto no negócio:  Zero burocracia. Suas ideias serão ouvidas e implementadas.

Pronto(a) para construir sua carreira e mudar sua vida?

Envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação (em inglês ou português), explicando por que você quer ser um(a) consultor(a) 360.

title: Desenvolvimento Java AWS - Pleno - 124105
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration,

implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory

requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role

requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business

environments.

Key responsibilities

• Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax,

and regulatory needs.

• Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and

CFOP determination.

• Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and

posting rules.

• Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

• Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

• Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

• Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.

Required skills and experience

• SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.

• Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document

requirements.

• System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.

• Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.

• Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.

• Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills

title: Sr Python Data Engineer
description:
Senior Python Data Engineer

About the Project


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using Python libraries (Pandas, Polars).
  • Develop and expose RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Consume and process normalized Parquet files from multiple upstream sources to generate dynamic Excel reports.
  • Contribute to a spec-driven development workflow (using GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to scaffold and generate API/data pipeline code.
  • Optimize report generation logic for speed and scalability, currently targeting sub-20 second response times.
  • Integrate with messaging and storage mechanisms (e.g., Service Bus, Storage Accounts).
  • Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code automation using Bicep (or similar IaC tools).
  • Participate in design discussions for future migration to Snowflake and/or a data lake architecture.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing (must have expertise in Pandas, nice to have: Polars, openpyxl).
  • Experience building backend services or APIs using frameworks like FastAPI.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling principles (Star Schema) and handling normalized datasets.
  • Familiarity with enterprise messaging patterns and data integration from various sources (API-based and file-based).
  • Experience working with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Bicep or comparable tools (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Comfort with spec-driven development and leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot for scaffolding.

• Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and

CFOP determination.

• Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and

posting rules.

• Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

• Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

• Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

• Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.

Required skills and experience

• SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.

• Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document

requirements.

• System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.

• Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.

• Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.

• Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:
Job Description — Microsoft MAUI Developer

Developros is partnering with a U.S. technology team to add a Microsoft MAUI Developer who can contribute to a modern cross-platform application used by thousands of customers. This role is ideal for a self-managing engineer with strong communication skills and a product mindset. You’ll work in real time with a U.S. team, shaping both the technical direction and the user experience.


Role Overview

You will design, build, and maintain cross-platform mobile/desktop applications using .NET MAUI. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in C#, architectural thinking, and an ability to collaborate closely with product and design. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and naturally contributes to team alignment and momentum.


Key Responsibilities
  • Develop high-quality mobile and desktop applications using .NET MAUI.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams in real time (EST/PST overlap).
  • Implement clean architecture, maintainable code, and scalable patterns.
  • Integrate REST APIs, authentication flows, and cloud services (Azure preferred).
  • Build UI components with a focus on performance, accessibility, and user experience.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, optimize performance, and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint rituals, and product planning discussions.


Required Skills & Experience
  • 3+ years of experience with C#/.NET development.
  • Hands-on experience with MAUI, Xamarin, or other cross-platform frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of MVVM patterns and reactive architectures.
  • Experience integrating APIs and working with cloud platforms (Azure is a plus).
  • Solid understanding of mobile/desktop lifecycle, memory management, and performance optimization.
  • Comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating directly with U.S. stakeholders.
  • Strong English communication, emotional intelligence, and proactive ownership.


Nice to Have
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Background in UI/UX collaboration or component design.
  • Experience with push notifications, offline sync, or advanced mobile capabilities.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools and instrumentation.


What Makes This Opportunity Unique
  • Joining through Developros means working with a partner that prioritizes team chemistry, long-term alignment, and human-centered collaboration . Our developers operate as trusted extensions of U.S. teams — not outsourced executors. You’ll work with leaders who value initiative, clarity, and craftsmanship.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil-based)
description:
About the Role

Mindhive builds AI-powered vision systems that transform industrial production. As we scale globally, reliability, observability, and rapid issue response are critical. The Platform Operations Team Lead (Brazil) plays a central role in ensuring our systems remain healthy across LATAM and European time zones.

You will lead the Platform Operations function — the customer-adjacent, reliability-focused counterpart to our Platform Engineering team in New Zealand. Your team will ensure our deployed systems are monitored, stable, recoverable, and well-understood by the rest of the business.

This role focuses on:

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.


Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.


Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating hybrid cloud + on-premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:

-Datadog (or similar observability platforms)

-AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)

-Containerization (Docker)

-Kubernetes / K3S

-IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)

  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on-call processes, or follow-the-sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware-integrated systems (ideal).


About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast-moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi-Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.


Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.


Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.

  • monitoring, alert quality, and fast incident response
  • supporting on-premise and edge deployments
  • improving operational processes and tooling
  • follow-the-sun coverage across Brazil and Portugal
  • ensuring operational readiness for engineering-led upgrades

You will collaborate closely with the NZ-based Platform Engineering team, who drive deep engineering projects (Puppet 8 rollout, Python 3.13 upgrade, CDK migration, CI/CD consistency, platform hardening, test-rig reliability). Together, you will form Mindhive’s global reliability backbone.

This is a hands-on leadership role with high impact on customer experience, system uptime, and our ability to scale installations worldwide.


About You

You are a strong operational leader with deep hands-on technical skills. You thrive in live production environments, enjoy solving real-world system issues, and understand how to build reliable systems across time zones. You excel in:

  • structured incident response
  • observability and monitoring
  • improving operational processes
  • leading teams in distributed, multicultural environments
  • working close to customers to ensure uptime and stability

You care about technical quality, clarity, and people — and you bring a mindset focused on resilience, collaboration, and steady improvement.


Key Competencies

  • Operational Excellence - builds systems, processes, and behaviours that improve stability and reliability.
  • Leadership & Mentorship - develops engineers and coordinates distributed teams.
  • Systems Thinking - sees the interplay between cloud, edge hardware, software, people, and processes.
  • Collaboration - works closely and constructively with NZ Platform Engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Calm Under Pressure - handles incidents and live issues with clarity and good judgement.
  • Continuous Improvement - always looking for ways to automate, simplify, and strengthen operations.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Operations Leadership

  • Lead and grow the Platform Operations team across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Build a high-performing follow-the-sun operational capability that supports both internal teams and customers.
  • Establish clear daily operational rhythms, including alert review, ticket management, and incident response.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor engineers and technicians across Brazil and Portugal.
  • Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure communication is clear, predictable, and aligned with our values.
  • Build a team that is highly accountable, collaborative, and customer-focused.

Observability & Monitoring

  • Own the quality and accuracy of Datadog dashboards, alerts, service catalog, resource catalog, and operational visibility.
  • Reduce alert noise, improve signal quality, and ensure teams receive actionable information.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.

Incident Response & Reliability

  • Oversee first-line and second-line incident response during LATAM and EU hours.
  • Ensure fast, structured triage for issues across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments.
  • Maintain clear escalation paths and strong communication practices during incidents.
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success teams to resolve client-facing issues.

Collaboration with Platform Engineering (NZ)

  • Act as the operational counterpart to NZ Platform Engineering.
  • Ensure operational readiness for major engineering initiatives, such as:

-Puppet 8 migration

-Python 3.13 upgrade

-CDK migration

-CI/CD unification

-Platform hardening

-Test rig and E2E reliability improvements

  • Provide field feedback, operational insights, and rollout support for these improvements.

System Health & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor the health of live systems across sites and proactively identify stability risks.
  • Help drive improvements in:

-edge hardware reliability

-network stability

-server provisioning consistency

-observability for both cloud and on-prem components

  • Work with teams to reduce operational toil and automate repetitive tasks.


Required Skills & Experience

Leadership & Communication

  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent communication in English and Portuguese.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, implementation, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong organisational skills with ability to manage competing priorities.

Technical

  • Strong background in DevOps, SRE, or Production Engineering environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating hybrid cloud + on-premise / edge systems.
  • Proficiency with:

-Datadog (or similar observability platforms)

-AWS (IAM, networking, security, monitoring)

-Containerization (Docker)

-Kubernetes / K3S

-IaC tools (AWS CDK ideal)

  • Solid programming skills in Python (TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus).
  • Understanding of security best practices (identity, access, endpoint, and network security).

Operational

  • Experience running incident response, on-call processes, or follow-the-sun operations.
  • Proven ability to write and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and operational documentation.
  • Experience supporting industrial, IoT, or hardware-integrated systems (ideal).


About Us

Mindhive Ltd is a fast-moving AI company using machine learning and computer vision to reimagine industrial systems. Our products run across cloud, on-premise, and edge deployments, bringing AI performance and reliability directly to the factory floor.

We care deeply about people, quality, and impact. We work collaboratively, iterate quickly, and tackle meaningful, complex problems.

Mindhive is a New Zealand Hi-Tech Awards winner, recognised for innovation and impact in software, AI, and advanced manufacturing.


Work Environment & Flexibility

We support hybrid and remote work, with our people distributed across Brazil, Portugal, Italy, Japan and New Zealand. We trust each other to deliver results in ways that suit our lives while maximising our collective impact. We move quickly, adapt fast, and support each other through the ups and downs that come with building something new and meaningful.


Our values

  • Relentless Curiosity - we explore deeply, question assumptions, and seek better ways.
  • Authentic Humanity - we support and care for people first.
  • Inclusive Connection - we collaborate openly and build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Determination to Deliver - we strive to do the right thing, consistently and with purpose.

description:

Descrição:

A mybest Brasil está em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência prática em limpeza doméstica para colaborar como consultor(a) especialista em nossos guias de compra e artigos sobre produtos e ferramentas para o lar.


Entre os temas que abordamos estão limpadores para azulejos e rejuntes, repelentes de pragas, aspiradores de pó, máquinas de lavar e outros produtos usados no dia a dia da casa .


Como funciona a colaboração:

  • Questionário: responder um breve formulário online indicando os critérios mais importantes para escolher cada tipo de produto (efetividade, segurança, facilidade de uso, durabilidade, custo-benefício, o que evitar etc.).
  • Revisão do artigo: revisar o rascunho antes da publicação para garantir precisão técnica e clareza nas recomendações.
  • Crédito: seu nome e mini bio aparecerão como especialista no artigo. Se tiver site ou blog profissional , incluímos o link no perfil (excelente oportunidade para aumentar sua autoridade e visibilidade).


Condições da colaboração:

  • Pagamento: R$ 350 por artigo (questionário + revisão).
  • Pagamento realizado até o dia 20 do mês seguinte à entrega.
  • Colaboração pontual, 100% remota.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada em limpeza e organização residencial , com conhecimento prático sobre produtos e utensílios domésticos.
  • Capacidade de emitir NFS-e de serviço de consultoria por CNPJ próprio fora do regime MEI .
  • Possuir site ou blog profissional ativo (não apenas redes sociais).


Desejável:

  • Familiaridade com Google Docs e Google Forms .
  • Clareza e objetividade ao transformar experiência prática em recomendações úteis para o público.


Observação:

Recebemos um volume alto de candidaturas e priorizamos respostas rápidas. Entraremos em contato por e-mail apenas com os candidatos cujo perfil atender às necessidades do projeto.


Sobre a mybest:

A mybest é a maior plataforma de recomendações de produtos do Japão, com operação em mais de 10 países, incluindo o Brasil. Nossos conteúdos combinam pesquisa editorial com a experiência de especialistas para ajudar milhões de leitores a comprar com segurança e confiança.


Se você é profissional de limpeza e quer compartilhar seu conhecimento com um público amplo, candidate-se e conte um pouco sobre sua experiência!
