Benefícios para você

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Gym Pass
  • Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos

  • Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian
  • Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos
  • Formação através da Trilha de Liderança

title: Data Analyst
description:
TapGoods


TapGoods is an exciting, fast-growing start-up that is revolutionizing how rental companies optimize and grow their businesses. We’re working to make it easy to rent. 


There are tens of thousands of businesses in the US that provide event, tool, audiovisual, and recreation rentals. This fragmented $722 billion global industry has not yet adopted modern systems and instead relies on pen & paper or cobbles together dated technology solutions. We’re building a solution that modernizes and dramatically improves the rental process for both businesses and their customers. 


Our product engineering team uses agile processes to continuously deliver incremental functionality on a weekly basis. We are constantly evolving, looking at every sprint as an opportunity to celebrate our success and learn how to improve. 


Data Analyst Role


We need a Data Analyst to join our team to fulfill our customers’ reporting needs. Our cloud platform provides analytics and reporting to our customers to help them manage their rental business. We’ve built a data warehouse and are moving our canned reports into embedded Power BI reports. 


This role would work closely with the product team and engineers to take our reporting to the next level. 


Responsibilities 


  • Use Power BI to create reports using our data warehouse 
  • Look for insights in our data that can provide value to our customers 
  • Maintain the Snowflake data warehouse dimensional model 
  • Be a part of our engineering team 
  • Able to work fully remote with adequate internet speeds, workspace, zoom capabilities (good mic, headset, etc.), and multiple monitors 


Requirements 


  • 1-3 years of experience with SQL 
  • Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools 
  • Experience with Power Query M 
  • Experience with Snowflake data warehouse 
  • Understanding data models for OLAP vs OLTP 
  • Experience with dimensional modeling/star schemas 
  • An unstoppable internal drive 
  • A great attitude and work ethic 
  • Solution oriented, self starter, and team player 
  • SaaS experience is a plus 


Our Culture


We are a nimble, fast-growing startup with a fully remote work environment. We have different backgrounds and life experiences that create a highly motivated, empowered and productive team. 


We are all committed to excellent work, whether it be one task or a big project - we believe in sticking things out until they are finished, and in communicating as quickly and effectively as possible when things get in the way of completing promised work. We are committed to improving the lives of our customers through our platform and our genuine care for them.

title: QA Funcional "981998"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Analisar requisitos funcionais e técnicos para identificar cenários de teste;

Criar, revisar e executar casos de teste manuais e automatizados;

Realizar testes funcionais, exploratórios, de regressão e aceitação;

Reportar e monitorar defeitos encontrados, garantindo sua correção;

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento, produto e design;

Garantir a cobertura de testes e a qualidade das entregas;

Auxiliar na definição e melhoria contínua dos processos de QA;

Participar das cerimônias ágeis (daily meetings, planning, review e retrospective);

Elaborar relatórios de testes e evidências de validação;

Apoiar na automatização de testes, quando necessário.


O que você precisa ter


  • Experiência comprovada em QA funcional;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de testes manuais e gestão de defeitos (Azure DevOps);
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar possíveis impactos e riscos em mudanças;
  • Conhecimento em testes de API (Postman, SoapUI);
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe;

title: Consultor de Recrutamento Júnior
description:
Recém-formado(a)? Fala inglês fluente e quer construir uma carreira onde sua renda depende diretamente dos seus esforços?

Nossa startup de recrutamento está buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Recrutamento Júnior .

Não buscamos um especialista pronto. Buscamos alguém com "brilho nos olhos", que possamos treinar no verdadeiro modelo 360  (sim, isso inclui Vendas e Recrutamento!). Você estará na origem da empresa, trabalhando lado a lado com os fundadores.

O que você vai fazer (e o que vamos te ensinar):

  • Parte 1: Negociação e Vendas (Prospecção)
  • Prospectar e atrair novos clientes (B2B), usando LinkedIn e contatos "frios".
  • Aprender a negociar com Diretores de RH e CEOs, fechando contratos de R&S.
  • Desenvolver relações de longo prazo com as empresas, tornando-se um parceiro estratégico.
  • Parte 2: Recrutamento (Delivery)
  • Conduzir o ciclo completo de recrutamento (do briefing com o cliente até a oferta).
  • Fazer "hunting" ativo dos melhores candidatos do mercado, que não estão em busca de emprego.
  • Conduzir entrevistas, avaliar perfis e apresentar os candidatos aos clientes.

Nosso(a) candidato(a) ideal:

  • Possui Ensino Superior completo.
  • Fala Inglês em nível avançado/fluente (conversacional)  — você vai se comunicar com candidatos e clientes internacionais.
  • Tem excelentes habilidades de comunicação:  você não tem medo de telefone, sabe ouvir, articula bem as ideias e tem poder de persuasão.
  • Tem um enorme desejo de se desenvolver  em negociação (vendas) e recrutamento (R&S).
  • É autônomo(a), proativo(a) e pronto(a) para atuar no ambiente dinâmico de uma startup.

Experiência prévia em R&S ou vendas é um diferencial, mas seu desejo e suas habilidades de comunicação são mais importantes.

O que oferecemos:

  • 100% Remoto (Home Office):  Trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Treinamento intensivo no modelo 360:  Vamos investir em você e transformá-lo(a) em um(a) consultor(a) de ponta.
  • Plano de carreira transparente:  Critérios claros de crescimento de Júnior a Sócio(a).
  • Salário e Motivação:  Salário base  competitivo (CLT) + alta remuneração variável (comissão)  baseada em seus resultados comerciais.
  • Impacto direto no negócio:  Zero burocracia. Suas ideias serão ouvidas e implementadas.

Pronto(a) para construir sua carreira e mudar sua vida?

Envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação (em inglês ou português), explicando por que você quer ser um(a) consultor(a) 360.

title: Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (JavaScript / RoR)We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience using Ruby on Rails to join as a core member of our U.S. client's tight-knit, experienced engineering team. In this role, you will play a leadership role as well as actively contribute to strategizing and building at the feature level rather than just focusing on outputs.

Our client is a venture capital-backed health tech company transforming the industry's coding practices by creating a marketplace that connects healthcare companies with over 4,000 certified coding specialists. The client is focused on expanding quickly its product, engineering, and design teams with passionate builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment to support its rapid growth.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define, design, and build new features and integrations
  • Advance software platform capabilities using Ruby on Rails
  • Develop and support third-party integrations with B2B healthcare systems
  • Provide work estimates for bug fixes, enhancements, and features
  • Deliver high-quality, well-documented code with velocity
  • Mentor junior engineers and aid the engineering team with troubleshooting
  • Write and execute unit tests
  • Promote development best practices following team standards with an eye towards innovation and opportunities to scale
  • Work independently with minimal need for oversight and a bias towards action as well as display a willingness to ask questions when needed to remain efficient
  • Become energized by tackling new challenges and eagerly give and receive feedback from colleagues


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience using Ruby on Rails, including version 7+, with a strong background in JavaScript and frameworks (preferably Stimulus)
  • Experience taking the lead on complete features, appropriate to your level, and showing initiative to solve ambiguous problems
  • Experience creating and consuming APIs
  • Knowledge of relational / non-relational database systems
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience in healthcare, healthtech industry, or growth stage startups
  • Experience with Stimulus, Turbo, Tailwind, Sidekiq, or Heroku Shield


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About the Company

Diib is a company based out of Salt Lake City, Utah. Diib’s mission is to make internet marketing clearer for individuals who don’t know anything about it. Diib helps small and medium businesses to find new ways to grow with Actionable Analytics, Industry-Based Ranking, and Custom Learning Tracks. 250k websites use Diib. The product is AI for SEO and other internet marketing aspects.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer who is passionate about delivering high-quality software, ensuring robust system performance, and driving automation best practices. In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.
  • Implement and manage test data and environments to ensure reliable and repeatable test execution.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define quality benchmarks and ensure test coverage for all requirements.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

  • Execute detailed automated and manual tests across multiple platforms and devices to validate functionality, usability, and performance.
  • Ensure that systems meet reliability, scalability, and availability expectations, especially in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) .
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions , particularly Amazon Redshift .
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms , such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).


What We Offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.

title: Senior Agile Tester
description:
Company Description:

Mojo Trek, an Inc. 5000 company, delivers an unparalleled technology recruitment experience, grounded in transparency and integrity. From midsize technology innovators to Fortune 50 powerhouse corporations, we help our clients build technology teams that make a difference. In addition to our strong presence in the Midwest and New York, we maintain an international footprint that enhances our ability to serve clients on a global scale.


We’re looking for a Senior Agile Tester who thrives in fast-moving, cross-functional environments and is passionate about ensuring quality from concept to deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with front-end developers, designers, and backend engineers to validate user experiences across responsive, content-driven applications built with modern technologies like React, Next.js, and headless CMSs.


Your mission is to advocate for quality across the entire product lifecycle — from exploratory testing and API validation to automation and continuous improvement within an agile delivery model.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and product owners in agile ceremonies to define and validate acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test plans for web applications using React / Next.js, ensuring responsive behavior across devices and browsers.
  • Test CMS integrations (Contentful, Strapi, Sanity) and validate localization and marketing content workflows.
  • Verify API Gateway / BFF layer integrations, ensuring clean data aggregation and performance across multiple channels.
  • Conduct exploratory, regression, and usability testing for front-end components built with Tailwind CSS and Storybook systems.
  • Validate deployments built via Vite for performance, caching, and build integrity.
  • Collaborate with developers to identify, report, and track defects using modern issue-tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for both UI and API test coverage.
  • Ensure accessibility, performance, and content accuracy across localized experiences.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing, preferably within agile or scrum environments.
  • Strong understanding of frontend architectures (React, Next.js, or similar).
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, CMS integrations, or decoupled web applications.
  • Proficiency with modern testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Postman, Jest).
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-based testing (Storybook or similar).
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively within agile teams.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and quality advocacy.


Nice to Have

  • Experience testing Drupal APIs and integrations with headless front-ends.
  • Knowledge of Vite builds, SSR, and hybrid rendering performance considerations.
  • Exposure to visual regression testing tools like Percy or Chromatic.
  • Familiarity with automated cross-browser and device testing suites.


What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to shape quality practices in a modern, front-end–driven product ecosystem.
  • Collaboration with an innovative design and development team using cutting-edge tools.
  • Flexible work environment focused on learning, iteration, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Desenvolvedor Android Sênior
description:
A Viajou  nasceu para resolver um problema que todo viajante já enfrentou: a confusão de organizar uma viagem do início ao fim. Nosso app reúne tecnologia, conteúdo e serviços de agência em uma única plataforma, oferecendo pacotes personalizados, suporte humano e integração total para que o usuário apenas curta a viagem.   • Jetpack Compose
  • Design Patterns

    • Implementação e manutenção de aplicativo de larga escala, injeção de dependências, estruturas de dados e algoritmos;

    • Vivência em planejamento e execução de aplicações em larga escala.

title: Cozinheira
description:
Cozinheiro(a) — Café Bonjour

O Café Bonjour é um espaço acolhedor, cheio de plantinhas, mimos e sabores preparados com carinho. Acreditamos que a cozinha é a alma da casa, e buscamos alguém que compartilhe desse cuidado, que valorize a estética, o sabor e a experiência que entregamos aos nossos clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Preparar e finalizar todos os itens salgados e doces do cardápio conforme fichas técnicas.
  • Garantir padronização, estética bonita e alto padrão de sabor em cada prato.
  • Realizar pré-preparo diário, organização da praça e reposição dos insumos da cozinha.
  • Manusear alimentos com excelência em higiene, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Controlar tempos de preparo, qualidade e agilidade no fluxo de pedidos.
  • Manter limpeza, organização e zelo pelos equipamentos, utensílios e ambiente.
  • Contribuir com ideias para melhorias de processos e novos preparos.
  • Trabalhar em equipe, mantendo um ambiente leve, colaborativo e profissional.

  • Saber fazer preparos de alimentos como carnes por exemplo
  • Agilidade, responsabilidade e boa comunicação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob demanda, mantendo qualidade e calma.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Oracle Finance Techno Functional Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


1. Oracle Finance Techno Functional Consultant #1

• Experience: 10+ years in Oracle EBS R12 Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA)

title: Inviting Senior Editors of EI Compendex Journals
description:
We are a seasoned academic service team dedicated to advancing international scholarly exchange and collaboration. To better support researchers worldwide in disseminating their work, we are now seeking experienced professionals like you—with a background as an editor or special issue organizer for EI Compendex-indexed journals —to join our expert team and contribute to elevating the quality and impact of academic papers.


We Are Looking For Candidates with the Following Profile:

  • A strong academic research background and a respected reputation in your field.
  • Must possess one of the following senior-level experiences:
  • Must currently be organizing and guest-editing a Special Issue for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.
  • Must currently be serving as an editor, associate editor, or editorial board member for an EI Compendex-indexed journal.


Your Role Will Include (Clear Academic Support Services):

  • Academic Review & Deep Polishing: Evaluate manuscripts for scientific rigor, logic, and originality, while refining academic expression, flow, and terminology to meet international publication standards.
  • Professional Translation & Grammar Polishing: Accurately translate Chinese research papers into natural, fluent academic English, ensuring correctness in grammar, spelling, and sentence structure.
  • Figure Optimization: Ensure all figures, charts, and images in the manuscript comply with the technical requirements of target journals, including but not limited to: format, layout, resolution (DPI), color mode, and file size.
  • Cover Letter Drafting: Assist authors in concisely summarizing the manuscript’s core strengths, innovations, and academic value in a compelling cover letter , enhancing its initial impression on journal editors.
  • Submission Assistance: Based on the article’s specific content, academic quality, and research field, recommend suitable journals indexed in the EI Compendex database for the author’s reference and selection.


Our Commitment and Emphasis (Core Compliance):

  • Full Compliance: All services we provide are strictly for “academic support” and absolutely do not involve any form of ghostwriting, data fabrication, or plagiarism . Your work will focus solely on improving the quality of the author’s original manuscript, with all final decisions remaining with the author.
  • No Acceptance Guarantee: We do not and cannot guarantee that any manuscript will be accepted. The final decision on publication rests entirely with the journal’s editors and peer-review process. Submission assistance is solely a recommendation based on content and does not imply any outcome.
  • Respect for Academic Integrity: We strictly adhere to publishing ethics standards (e.g., COPE guidelines). Our services are designed to help authors overcome language, presentation, and technical barriers, not to replace their core research work.


By Joining Us, You Will Receive:

  • Competitive remuneration and flexible working hours that fully respect your academic schedule.
  • Opportunities to engage with cutting-edge research and exchange ideas with outstanding global scholars.
  • The professional satisfaction of contributing to clearer, more standardized, and influential scientific communication.

If our mission resonates with you, and you wish to leverage your senior experience to help more scholars share their work globally, we sincerely invite you to get in touch.


We look forward to partnering with you in upholding the beacon of academic excellence!

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:

Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web

applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is

highly desirable.

analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

stakeholders.

efficient platform.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Senior Software QA Engineer


Location: Brazil Fully Remote

Reports To: Head of QA/ Engineering Manager

Setup: Consultancy/PJ

Must Have: English Resume and Professional level of English Communication Skills


About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Sr QA Engineer with strong experience in both automated and manual testing. This role is critical to ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and user experience. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to design and execute test plans, build automated test suites, and champion quality across the entire software development lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning & Execution
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and potential risks.
  • Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases covering functional, regression, integration, and performance scenarios.
  • Perform manual testing for exploratory, usability, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Test Automation
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites (UI, API, and regression).
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality feedback.
  • Monitor and maintain test results, ensuring failures are triaged quickly.
  • Defect Tracking & Reporting
  • Log, prioritize, and track defects using issue tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure Linear).
  • Partner with developers to reproduce, debug, and verify fixes.
  • Provide clear reporting on test coverage, pass/fail rates, and quality trends.
  • Quality Advocacy
  • Participate in design reviews, backlog grooming, and sprint planning to identify potential issues early.
  • Suggest process improvements to enhance efficiency and prevent defects.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, Software Tester, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in writing automated tests using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar .
  • Experience testing APIs using tools like Postman , REST Assured, or similar.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


Why Join Us

  • Work with a collaborative, high-performing engineering team that values quality at every step.
  • Opportunity to shape and improve our test automation strategy and quality processes.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Test Engineer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only ), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the Role:

As a Senior Test Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of web and API-based applications. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to design and execute test strategies that support modern engineering practices and high-quality software delivery.

This role is ideal for someone with strong automation expertise, a deep understanding of quality engineering, and the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed Agile teams.

  • Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for web applications using Selenium WebDriver .
  • Create and maintain automated tests for RESTful APIs, including validation of headers, payloads, and data structures.
  • Develop and support test frameworks using Java , Cucumber , and Maven .
  • Configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines within Jenkins , integrating version control and build tools.

  • Good experience with Jenkins , including job configuration and integrating Git/SVN and Maven.

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

title: Dev Sênior React / Node (com VTEX) (BRL 15-16K/mês PJ)
description:
Nosso cliente atua em uma etapa da compra online conhecida como "checkout" - trata-se do momento em que o consumidor precisa finalizar a compra, preenchendo o cadastro e informações de pagamento.


Em integração com os serviços de lojistas, nosso cliente oferece um sistema que preenche automaticamente os dados do comprador na hora de fechar compras.


Para fazer isso, a plataforma da startup funciona com cadastros únicos para diferentes lojas: depois que o cliente faz uma primeira compra em uma loja, as informações ficam armazenadas para serem usadas em outras lojas cadastradas no sistema do nosso cliente.


O modelo de negócios da empresa funciona com cobranças nas transações.


DESCRIÇÃO DO SKILL SET

  • Experiência como Desenvolvedor Frontend e Backend React / Node (5 anos +);
  • Experiência com a plataforma VTEX
  • Experiência com React;
  • Experiência com Javascript e Typescript;
  • Experiência com arquitetura;
  • Experiência com definição de tecnologias e arquitetura;
  • Conhecimento de Cloud AWS, Heroku e MongoDB

title: Senior Python Software Engineer (AI)
description:
About Pyyne

Pyyne is a modern technology consultancy engineering the next generation of digital products and services.


At Pyyne, we believe in using technology to unlock business potential, create sustainable growth, and drive forward digital excellence. Our solutions range from advanced Software Engineering, Cloud, and Data & AI solutions.


Job Summary

Pyyne is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, skilled in Python and with experience developing solutions with LLMs to work as a Consultant out of our Brazilian Office. This is a high-impact role for Pyyne as we scale up our AI Services and onboard new and exciting clients in this sector. 


A successful candidate in this role will be self-motivated and responsible for the full product lifecycle, from architecting scalable systems to rapid prototyping and experimentation. If you are passionate about building robust, high-quality systems and want to make a significant impact on an innovative product, this role is for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect & Build : Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP that serve as the backbone for our AI-powered products.
  • Develop AI Solutions: Implement and optimize sophisticated AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, to solve complex client problems.
  • Innovate & Experiment: Rapidly prototype and experiment with cutting-edge LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and tool integration.
  • Champion Code Quality: Take ownership of the development lifecycle and champion best practices for writing clean, well-tested, and maintainable code.
  • Collaborate & Lead: Work closely with product, data, and business stakeholders to shape the AI product roadmap and provide technical leadership.


Must Have Skills: 

  • Expert-Level Python: 3+ years of professional experience with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python and its ecosystem for building robust APIs and data-driven applications.
  • Production Cloud Experience: A proven track record of designing, building, and deploying scalable, production-grade applications on AWS or GCP. You are comfortable with core services like Lambda/Cloud Functions, S3/Cloud Storage, EC2/Compute Engine, etc.
  • Hands-On AI Experience: You have built and shipped at least one AI-powered feature or application, demonstrating your ability to translate AI concepts into real-world solutions.
  • Engineering Excellence: You are a self-starter who takes ownership, writes
  • high-quality, maintainable code, and has a keen eye for detail.


Nice to Have Skills: 

  • Applied AI Development: Hands-on experience developing solutions with LLMs (e.g. via OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere APIs) and/or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK).
  • AI Infrastructure: Familiarity with services like AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
  • Vector Databases: Knowledge of vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and semantic search concepts.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • Salary Range from 3,443 - 4,120 USD/mo  
  • Flexible remote working environment.
  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.

title: Master Data Manager
description:
Vaga: MDM Tester – Híbrido em São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um(a) MDM Tester experiente e detalhista para se juntar ao nosso time e contribuir com o sucesso da nossa iniciativa de Master Data Management (MDM) .


A posição é híbrida em São Paulo , com a oportunidade de atuar em projetos de dados de grande porte e impacto global.


Como MDM Tester , você será responsável por investigar e resolver falhas de qualidade de dados, analisar fontes e processos de ingestão, além de garantir a precisão, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados mestres em diversos sistemas.


Responsabilidades

  • Testar e validar dados mestres, assegurando qualidade, consistência e precisão entre diferentes sistemas;
  • Investigar gaps de conhecimento e perfilar fontes de dados;
  • Analisar e validar datasets de sistemas de origem para suportar migração e relatórios;
  • Colaborar com times de negócio e tecnologia para garantir alinhamento em políticas de governança e qualidade de dados;
  • Apoiar fluxos e automações de dados, contribuindo com melhorias contínuas nos pipelines.


✅ Requisitos

  • 5+ anos de experiência em Data/ETL Testing ;
  • 6+ anos de experiência em gestão e governança de qualidade de dados em ambiente MDM;
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de dados e integração de dados ;
  • Experiência com ferramentas ETL (Ab Initio, AWS Glue, Informatica, Alteryx);
  • Vivência com CI/CD (GitLab) e práticas de DevOps/DataOps ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com equipes multifuncionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com MDM em nuvem ;
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de migração, validação ou limpeza de dados em larga escala.
  • Experiência prática com Stibo MDM ;


Local e Modelo

  • Híbrido – São Paulo
  • Contrato PJ

¡El español avanzado para conversar con usuarios de Latinoamérica es un requisito indispensable!

• Sólidos conocimientos de arquitectura de software y mejores prácticas de desarrollo.

• Experiencia con bases de datos relacionales (PostgreSQL, SQL) y fundamentos de bases de datos no relacionales.

• Experiencia con pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions o similar). • Experiencia con pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions o similar).

• Experiencia en el desarrollo de APIs RESTful e integraciones de sistemas.

Expectativas salariales a convenir.

title: Analista de Planejamento e Inteligência de Mercado II
description:
A Voltz é a fintech do Grupo Energisa.


Somos um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis e geradores de valor nos ecossistemas de serviços básicos.


Começamos com a oferta de serviços digitais para pessoas físicas e expandimos nossa atuação para meios de pagamento e soluções para gestão financeira.


Além disso, oferecemos possibilidades de negociação para consumidores de serviços essenciais e crédito para fornecedores.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


O dia a dia:

• Conduzir pesquisas de mercado, monitorar tendências, perfis de concorrentes, cenários emergentes e oportunidades de crescimento (por exemplo: avaliar segmentos inexplorados, modelagem de cenário);


• Mapear novos negócios: apoiar iniciativas de pré-análise, desenvolver business cases, estimativas de mercado, participação provável, modelos de monetização;


• Acompanhar metas estratégicas, táticas e operacionais: definir painéis de indicadores (KPIs), monitorar progresso, identificar desvios, sugerir ações corretivas;


• Preparar relatórios e apresentações executivas periódicas (mensais, trimestrais) para a diretoria: sintetizar dados, contar a “história” por trás dos números, transformar informação em insight e recomendação;

• Apoiar a implementação de processos e ritos de governança de metas, alinhamento de coordenações/produtos e interface com outras áreas (Crédito, Cobrança, Produto, Negócios);


• Gerar e manter base de dados de inteligência de mercado/concorrência, dashboards, relatórios de desempenho e painéis de acompanhamento;


• Colaborar com outras áreas para garantir que as informações estejam atualizadas, consistentes e disponíveis para decisão.



Requisitos e qualificações

• Formação superior (Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing, Estatística ou afins).


• Experiência prévia (2-4 anos ou mais) em inteligência de mercado, novos negócios, análise competitiva ou similar;


• Sólidas habilidades analíticas e de interpretação de dados: capacidade de extrair padrões, insights e implicações para o negócio


• Boa habilidade de comunicação, para preparar relatórios executivos e interagir com níveis de gerência e diretoria;


• Familiaridade ou vontade de aprender ferramentas de BI/visualização de dados (Excel avançado, Power BI/Tableau, SQL ou equivalente) embora foco não seja engenharia de dados pesada;


• Proatividade, curiosidade estratégica, visão de negócio, capacidade de trabalhar com ambiguidade e traduzir dados em recomendação;


• Será considerando um diferencial: experiência ou familiaridade com segmento de fintech, crédito ou área financeira, considerando seu contexto de produto de crédito.


Informações adicionais


OS BENEFÍCIOS PARA OS VOLTZERS


  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação.
  • Wellhub;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR atrelado a metas e resultados;
  • Conexa (atendimento médico e psicológico online e 100% gratuito);

title: Analista de CRM – Consultor de Implementação HubSpot
description:
Se você entende tudo de HubSpot, esta vaga é para você!


Posição: Analista de CRM - Consultor de Implementação HubSpot

Local: Remoto (Brasil)

Modelo de Trabalho: Full-time (PJ)


Sobre a Hack Your Marketing e sobre a vaga:


A Hack Your Marketing (HYM) atua com soluções integradas de Growth Marketing e Revenue Operations (RevOps) para empresas de tecnologia, sempre com foco em performance, automação e escalabilidade.


Somos parceiros HubSpot no Brasil e um dos nossos diferenciais é a especialização em implementação e sustentação de HubSpot, plataforma que utilizamos para transformar operações de marketing, vendas e customer success. Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor de HubSpot para compor nosso time e apoiar a operação e evolução dos sistemas de CRM dos nossos clientes.


Responsabilidades:


  • Gestão e manutenção de contas HubSpot: Atualizar, configurar e monitorar os módulos de Hubspot, garantindo organização e integridade dos dados.


  • Suporte a implementações e integrações: Apoiar o time nas fases de implementação do HubSpot, realizando configurações, testes e validações operacionais.


  • Atualização e segmentação de bases de dados: Garantir que os dados dos contatos e empresas estejam atualizados, corretamente segmentados e organizados para uso em campanhas e relatórios.


  • Criação e manutenção de relatórios simples: Gerar dashboards e relatórios operacionais em HubSpot para apoiar a análise de performance.


  • Apoio na automação de processos: Criar e revisar automações (workflows) no HubSpot, com foco na melhoria da eficiência dos processos internos dos clientes.


  • Documentação de processos e configurações: Registrar procedimentos, fluxos e padrões de uso do HubSpot para garantir consistência e escalabilidade.


  • Atendimento ao cliente: Ser o principal ponto de contato entre a agência e cliente, conduzir reuniões, dar suporte a utilização do HubSpot via WhatsApp e videoconferência.


Requisitos:


  • Boa fluência em Excel: Habilidade para criar planilhas, análises simples e organizar dados estruturados.


  • Raciocínio lógico e atenção a detalhes: Capacidade de entender fluxos e processos de negócios e traduzi-los para estruturas dentro do CRM.


  • Organização e proatividade: Perfil analítico, curioso e com iniciativa para aprender e resolver problemas com autonomia.


  • Interesse por tecnologia e marketing: Vontade de se desenvolver na área de CRM, automação e processos de marketing e vendas B2B.


  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal: Clareza para documentar processos e interagir com diferentes áreas e clientes.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia com CRM (como HubSpot, Salesforce, RD Station, Pipedrive etc.)


  • Experiência prévia com serviços de consultoria


  • Familiaridade com o mercado SaaS ou com empresas de tecnologia B2B.


  • Noções básicas de automação de marketing, jornada do cliente e funil de vendas.


  • Conhecimento básico de ferramentas como Google Looker Studio, Notion ou ClickUp.


O que oferecemos:


  • Flexibilidade para trabalho remoto e autonomia no dia a dia.


  • Treinamentos e certificações em HubSpot.


  • Acompanhamento técnico e oportunidades reais de crescimento.


  • Ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com forte cultura de aprendizado.


  • Contato direto com clientes SaaS em diferentes estágios de crescimento.

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Executivo de Negócios
description:
Você será responsável por abrir portas com empresários e decisores nos setores estratégicos da Karizoda — tanto no Brasil quanto nos Estados Unidos — atuando como hunter de alta performance e closer estratégico em vendas consultivas.


Mais do que vender serviços, seu papel será vender visão, diagnóstico e resultado . Isso exige habilidade para criar conexões em ambientes frios, gerar autoridade em contextos desafiadores e manter controle sobre um ciclo de vendas que envolve múltiplas etapas, personas e canais.


Buscamos um(a) profissional de mercado, com inglês fluente, experiência em vendas consultivas de growth ou produtos de marketing. Com capacidade para construção, implementação de processos e fechamento de vendas.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Prospecção ativa (hunter real).
  • Pesquisa e identificação de leads estratégicos.
  • Construção de cadências de cold email, cold call e social selling.
  • Extração de leads de comunidades como G4 e C12 com cadências segmentadas.
  • Condução completa da jornada do lead.
  • Realizar abordagens frias com copy inteligente e contextual.
  • Agendar e conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico com foco em venda consultiva.
  • Personalizar propostas e apresentações com base nos desafios do cliente.
  • Fechamento de contratos e acompanhamento do pipeline.
  • Trabalhar em CRM de forma disciplinada (nada de “controle paralelo”).
  • Garantir follow-ups com inteligência e senso de urgência.
  • Atuar com metas claras de reuniões, propostas enviadas e contratos fechados.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com marketing para retroalimentar os dados de personas.
  • Contribuir com feedbacks sobre objeções, ICPs e canais mais eficazes.
  • Participar da evolução do playbook comercial junto à liderança.
  • Atuar com o mercado nacional e internacional, principalmente EUA.
  • Apoiar a liderança no planejamento estratégico de abertura de novos mercados, desde as etapas de pesquisa até a implementação de novos funis de prospecção, processos de vendas e fechamentos, assim como a tomada de decisões estratégicas relacionadas à área Comercial.


REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS


Imprescindíveis:


  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing, Vendas, Comunicação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência real com prospecção fria multicanal (cold call, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp).
  • Domínio de CRM (HubSpot ou similares) e ferramentas de sales intelligence.
  • Inglês fluente (nível avançado para calls comerciais).
  • Autonomia para gerar resultados com ritmo e organização.


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia vendendo para os EUA ou tendo atuado em ambientes globais.
  • Familiaridade com vendas em comunidades, redes de relacionamento e eventos (ex.: G4, C12, grupos setoriais).
  • Vivência com produtos e serviços de marketing, growth ou tecnologia.


REQUISITOS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Forte inteligência emocional, capaz de lidar com conflitos internos e externos, agindo com maturidade com foco em resultados;
  • Habilidade em dar e receber feedback, reconhecendo os erros com humildade, buscando ações que apresentem soluções práticas e rápidas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e influência.
  • Proatividade, organização e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Discrição e confiabilidade – Essencial para lidar com informações sensíveis da empresa;
  • Autonomia e autorresponsabilidade: Capacidade de tomar decisões de forma estruturada e eficiente.


O QUE OFERECEMOS:


  • Ambiente de Trabalho: 100% remoto, pautado em autonomia e confiança;
  • Modelo de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);
  • Day off de aniversário: Um dia de folga no seu aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado: 15 dias anuais de recesso;
  • Bonificação por tempo de contrato.
  • Faixa contratual (PJ): R$ 4.500,00 a R$ 7.000,00 fixo mensal + variável. (o valor final será definido com base na avaliação das soft skills, habilidades técnicas (hard skills) e na experiência comprovada do(a) candidato(a)).

title: Microsoft MAUI Developer
description:

title: Salesforce Developer | UI Focused
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Salesforce UI Developer to help build a next-generation compliance and reporting platform used in the clean energy and infrastructure space.

You’ll be part of a dedicated Salesforce product engineering team that’s building scalable, data-driven applications entirely on Salesforce — with Lightning Web Components (LWC) powering a modern, dynamic user experience.

This is a hands-on engineering role , ideal for developers who live at the intersection of front-end design and Salesforce architecture — people who write clean, modular code and care deeply about performance, usability, and aesthetics.


What You’ll Do
  • Design and develop Lightning Web Components (LWCs) and Aura components for custom pages, dashboards, and portals.
  • Build and customize Experience Cloud sites for customers, partners, and internal teams — working with themes, branding sets, and custom navigation.
  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to bring mockups and design systems to life while maintaining Lightning Design System (SLDS) standards.
  • Integrate LWCs with Apex controllers and REST APIs , ensuring efficient data flow between the front-end and backend systems.
  • Implement performance optimizations such as caching, pagination, and lazy loading for large datasets.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing (Jest, Apex), and CI/CD pipelines to ensure high-quality, maintainable releases.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions, documentation standards, and reusable component libraries.


What We’re Looking For
  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience , including at least 2 years focused on Lightning Web Components (LWC) .
  • Proven experience building and customizing Experience Cloud (Community Cloud) portals.
  • Strong understanding of Apex, Salesforce DX, and data model design .
  • Solid front-end fundamentals: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 , and ideally TypeScript .
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST APIs or Platform Events .
  • Familiarity with Git-based DevOps tools such as Copado, Gearset, or Bitbucket Pipelines.
  • Certifications: Salesforce Platform Developer I and JavaScript Developer I (required). Platform Developer II or Experience Cloud Consultant are strong pluses.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, design, and product teams.


Nice to Have
  • Background in UI/UX or front-end design (e.g., Figma, SLDS customization).
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems or reusable component libraries .
  • Knowledge of CI/CD automation , unit testing , and code quality frameworks

﻿ .

Why This Role
  • You’ll work with a team that treats Salesforce as a true engineering platform , not just a configuration tool. This is a chance to own the front-end experience of a product used across major infrastructure and renewable energy projects, where performance, polish, and usability truly matter.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Hartmann Young is partnered with a fast-growing global leader in health, nutrition, and wellness ingredients, known for its science-led innovation and rapid international expansion. As the business continues to scale, we are seeking a dynamic Business Development Manager South America to drive immediate commercial impact and elevate the company’s presence across the nutraceutical market.


We’re looking for someone who brings genuine industry influence, including:

  • A strong book of business and established relationships with brand owners, CMOs/CDMOs, and major consumer health companies
  • Proven success selling key nutraceutical dosage forms — tablets, capsules, softgels, and gummys.


If you’re commercially driven, well-connected, and excited by the opportunity to shape partnerships in a high-growth environment, this role offers an exceptional platform to make a meaningful and immediate impact.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new business growth by leveraging your existing network and opening high-value commercial opportunities
  • Develop and expand strategic partnerships with global key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and contract manufacturers
  • Lead the full business development cycle — from opportunity identification to negotiation and long-term strategic planning
  • Translate scientific and technical capabilities into compelling commercial propositions
  • Collaborate closely with R&D, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to deliver integrated go-to-market strategies
  • Manage contracts, commercial terms, and performance optimisation across partnership lifecycles
  • Support international expansion through new market development and strategic alliances
  • Represent the business at leading industry trade shows and events to strengthen brand visibility and network reach.


Key Requirements

  • You can be located anywhere within South America to qualify for this market.
  • 8+ years’ experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial leadership within nutraceuticals, ingredients, food, or life sciences within South America.
  • A well-established book of business and strong relationships across the nutraceutical ecosystem
  • Direct experience selling tablets, capsules, softgels, gummys, or related dosage forms
  • Proven ability to generate revenue growth and close complex commercial agreements
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to convert technical innovation into business value
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth, hands-on environment
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager who will become a strategic partner to the CEO and take full ownership of the marketing function.

You will be the key person responsible for building the marketing strategy, managing the team, and driving company growth.


Key Areas of Responsibility

Cross-functional marketing team leadership

  • Manage a team of SMM specialists, media buyers, email marketers, and content creators
  • Create clear briefs and tasks for designers and copywriters
  • Coordinate workflows between Marketing ↔ Sales ↔ Product
  • Ensure quality and timely execution across all marketing activities

Content strategy & production

  • Develop and oversee the content strategy across all channels
  • Lead the creation of client case studies (we have 100+ success stories!)
  • Adapt marketing and educational content for new markets (EU, US)
  • Maintain a consistent tone of voice and content quality

Growth & lead generation

  • Plan and host webinars and educational events
  • Launch email sequences, tripwires, and marketing funnels
  • Set up chatbot automation flows (Telegram, website)
  • Build partnerships and collaborations to scale lead generation

Analytics & optimization

  • Track channel performance, CAC, CPL, and funnel metrics
  • Calculate campaign ROI and conversion improvements
  • Optimize active campaigns to improve CAC, LTV and retention
  • Build and refine CJMs and conversion funnels

Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • Marketing team exists, but execution lacks consistency — we need a system
  • Sales launched in Europe (Finland, Germany) — marketing needs localization
  • Sales launched for English-speaking U.S. audiences — marketing must adapt
  • We have 100+ client case studies and podcast episodes ready for marketing use


Challenges you will help solve:

Content

  • No consistent content production framework
  • Client case studies are produced irregularly
  • Need adaptation for new markets
  • Content quality must be stabilized and elevated

Processes

  • Team accountability and task ownership must be improved
  • Need transparent metric tracking for optimization
  • No unified coordination between Marketing ↔ Sales

Scaling

  • Growth goal: 3× in 6 months
  • Expansion into new markets (Finland, Germany)
  • Strengthening position in the U.S.
  • Channel diversification and testing


What You Will Do

Strategy & Leadership (30%)

  • Build quarterly / monthly / weekly marketing plans
  • Manage and mentor SMM, email, and paid traffic teams
  • Write briefs and task descriptions for creatives and specialists
  • Run regular syncs with team and stakeholders
  • Prioritize initiatives and ensure deadlines are met

Content & Creative (25%)

  • Develop content strategy for SMM, email, webinars, landing pages
  • Lead the production of case studies and educational content
  • Work with designers and copywriters: briefs, quality review
  • Adapt content for different audiences and markets
  • Maintain a unified tone of voice

Lead Generation & Funnels (25%)

  • Plan and execute webinars end-to-end
  • Launch email campaigns, tripwires, and automated funnels
  • Build and optimize chatbot logic and conversion flows
  • Develop partnerships, media placements, and collaborations
  • Build CJMs and warming funnels

Analytics & Optimization (20%)

  • Analyze key metrics (CAC, CPL, conversions, ROI)
  • Produce channel and campaign performance reports
  • Optimize existing marketing activities based on data
  • Test new channels and hypotheses
  • Work with analytics tools (GA, CRM, marketing platforms)


Requirements

Must Have

Experience in EdTech or SaaS — 2+ years

  • Strong understanding of how educational/SaaS funnels work
  • B2C marketing experience in career/learning segments
  • Experience with performance metrics and ROI-oriented marketing

High-growth startup experience

  • Ability to work in a fast-changing environment
  • Skilled in prioritization and multitasking
  • Experience contributing to 2x–3x growth

Marketing team management — 1+ year

  • Ability to assign and brief tasks clearly
  • Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders
  • Delegation and performance oversight

Tools & technical marketing skills

  • Email marketing (Klaviyo, SendGrid, or similar)
  • Chatbots and automation funnels
  • Analytics (Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel)
  • SMM + paid advertising experience
  • Webflow / Figma / Notion for content collaboration

CJM & funnel expertise

  • Experience designing customer journey maps
  • Building content-based nurturing funnels
  • Understanding of CAC, LTV, ROMI, conversion metrics

Strong Plus

Experience running webinars and online events

Copywriting and editing skills

Knowledge of U.S./EU job markets

Experience using LinkedIn for lead generation

Background in mission-driven or social impact projects

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:
Desenvolvedor Salesforce Senior (Apex, LWC, OmniStudio)


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Salesforce com sólida experiência em Apex, LWC e OmniStudio para atuar no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução da nossa plataforma Salesforce. Esse profissional será responsável por implementar soluções escaláveis, garantir qualidade técnica, apoiar integrações complexas e colaborar com áreas de negócio em processos críticos.

(Core Salesforce) Experiência avançada em Apex: Batch, Trigger, Scheduler. Forte domínio em Integrações REST e SOAP. Experiência com Flow, incluindo Flow Trigger e Flow Screen. Utilização de GIT (branching, versionamento, code review). Ferramentas de automação, preferencialmente Jenkins.


Diferenciais Certificações Salesforce (Admin, Platform Developer I/II, OmniStudio Developer/Consultant). Experiência em projetos de alta complexidade ou ambientes multiorganização. Conhecimento em CI/CD específico para Salesforce.
